caption: The two curves use the worked example: net load 9 kN/m on an 8 m semi-span. Both vanish at the free tip and, for this uniform load, reach their largest values at the root. The moment curve reaches the higher number on the shared axis, but the two curves carry different units, kN and kN·m, so read each against its own quantity.

spec.aria: Shear force and bending moment along a wing semi-span for a uniform net load, both falling to zero at the tip and largest at the root. The moment curve reaches the higher number on the shared axis; the units differ, kN and kN·m.
